# System prompt layers

The system prompt is sent as one block per tier, each ending at a prompt-cache breakpoint. Layers appear in this order; empty layers are left out. See [Turns and the system prompt](../guide/turns.md).

## `static`

| Layer | Contents |
|---|---|
| `identity` | The profile's `SOUL.md` when it exists and is not empty, else the built-in identity. |
| `tool_guidance` | How to use the tools the session was given. |
| `model_guidance` | Advice for the model family, when one applies. |

## `profile`

| Layer | Contents |
|---|---|
| `platform_hint` | The surface's hint, changed by `prompt.platform_hints.<platform>`. |
| `skills_index` | The index of available skills. |
| `pinned_skills` | Skills loaded into every session. |

## `session`

| Layer | Contents |
|---|---|
| `personality` | The `agent.personality` overlay. |
| `caller_system` | The caller's own system message. |
| `project_context` | Project context files under `# Project Context`. |
| `memory` | The memory and user-profile snapshot taken at session start. |
| `plugin_sections` | Sections contributed by plugins. |
| `session_info` | The session start time and, with `prompt.include_session_id`, `Session ID: ses_<ULID>`. |
| `runtime` | The runtime environment block, always the last text of the prompt. |
